newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) end higher.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) end higher.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Thursday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover fell slightly to 4.3 billion yuan from 4.4 billion yuan with the seven-day contract again the most active.
Traders said new issues and listings on the domestic A share market in the next few days supported the seven-day contract, keeping it the most active.

Results of a meeting on Tuesday in Beijing to discuss a ban on state banks trading on the repo market were not issued today, pushing some short-term financial centres to buy on the interbank market, one trader said.

"Many traders believe commercial banks will be prohibited from trading on the repo market in the next few days," said one trader. "So since Tuesday they been taking advantage of their remaining opportunities to trade."
